Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.ratelimit

package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.ratelimit
Servlet filter and admin REST controller for global rate limiting (EPIC-13).
  • RateLimitFilter (US-13-005) — outermost filter in the Spring Security chain.
  • RateLimitAdminController (US-13-006) — admin endpoints under /admin/rate-limit.

The Bucket4j adapter implementing RateLimitGate lives under infrastructure/ratelimit/ (US-13-004), separate from the web layer so that Bucket4j classes do not creep into the servlet package.

  • Class
    Description
    RateLimitAdminController
    Admin REST adapter for the live rate-limit configuration (REQ-RL-004, design §6.2.4).
    RateLimitConfigRequest
    Wire request body for PUT /admin/rate-limit.
    RateLimitConfigResponse
    Wire response shape for GET /admin/rate-limit and PUT /admin/rate-limit.
    RateLimitFilter
    Outermost filter in the Spring Security chain — global Bucket4j gate (REQ-RL-001 / REQ-RL-003).
    RateLimitProbeController
    Test-only probe controller used by RateLimitFilterIntegrationTest to drive the global Bucket4j filter through a real Spring Security chain without leaning on any feature endpoint.
